rules: Every source row needs source URL, owner, access time, and source-page updated label when available.
Every linked source document needs locator, document title, issuer, date label, source page, accession timestamp, and hash if locally frozen.
Documents not locally frozen are locator-pinned only and cannot support irreversible extraction.
A citation supports only the exact claim state it can carry.
open_decisions: Whether to mirror official PDFs locally or store locator+hash only.
How to handle dead links for government PDFs that later move or disappear.
Which public web archive services are acceptable for redundancy.
